Add arrow-key tooltip navigation to an echarts4r chart

Source: R/ro_e_keyboard.R
ro_e_keyboard_nav.Rd

Internal: called by ro_e_standard(). Attaches a keydown listener that moves the tooltip across data points with the arrow keys. Direction is auto-detected from the chart orientation (echarts4r::e_flip_coords() gives up/down, otherwise left/right), or set explicitly via axis.

Usage

ro_e_keyboard_nav(e, axis = NULL)

Arguments

e

An echarts4r object.

axis

Character. One of "horizontal", "vertical", or "both". Default NULL auto-detects from the chart orientation.

Value

The modified echarts4r object, with keyboard navigation attached via htmlwidgets::onRender().
